style.backgroundSystem: seamless white #FFFFFF packshot field alternating with an airy sky-blue #A9CBE4 daylight field and a creamy nude-beige #EBD6C0 swatch surface; flat graphic panels use a white #FFFFFF card inside the sky-blue frame
style.direction: clean airy base-makeup ecommerce with a shade-matching spine
style.iconSystem: thin-line tick marks and rounded numbered step markers in white #FFFFFF on a deep plum #6B2E70 ribbon
style.lightingSystem: bright cool-neutral high-key studio light, large soft front key with fill card, sweeping highlight along glass edges, soft contact shadows only, no harsh speculars
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clean airy base-makeup visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless white #FFFFFF, airy sky-blue #A9CBE4, creamy nude-beige #EBD6C0 and one deep plum accent #6B2E70; bright cool-neutral high-key studio lighting with a large soft front key, fill card, sweeping highlights along glass edges and soft contact shadows only; modern geometric sans-serif with short headline lines; thin-line tick icons and rounded numbered step markers on a deep plum ribbon; flat graphic panels use a white card inside a sky-blue frame; stable upright slight 3/4 product scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no shade numbers or colour names rendered on image
style.presentationRules: bottle stays upright at a stable slight 3/4 or straight-on scale across packshot and scene shots; swatch ribbons are always single sweeping strokes with a tapered tail
style.surfaceSystem: matte creamy nude-beige #EBD6C0 swatch surface and seamless white #FFFFFF paper; overhead graphic panels sit on a matte white card
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, short headline lines plus thin label rows, all copy carried by placeholders in charcoal #33383D or white #FFFFFF
